rule: TOWN_1's: of the aims meeting the criterion, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of day-1 entries naming it. Keeping the bank funded (its credits are finite and wages drain it): nine proposals in day 1, five passed — P1 (Iris, c2: when the bank has fewer than 100, citizens above 100 give 10), P4 (Gale, c6: workers may voluntarily give 1 at cycle end), P6 (Heath, c13), P7 (Cedar, c17), P9 (Juniper, c22) — two posts urging votes «to keep the bank solvent», and voluntary gifts to the bank (six in day 1): 10 of 10 citizens name it. Work at the bank and rest are named by 10 and 9 as practice, not as a joint aim. Wording for the notice, the citizens' own: «keeping the bank solvent» (Gale c5 «helping keep the bank solvent», Alder c8 «To keep the bank solvent»).
reading: From c1 the citizens noted that the bank's 1000 credits pay wages and will run out («Bank will run out unless funded», Iris c1). The day is a run of rules for refilling it: P1 passed at c3; P2 and P3 (compulsory contributions) failed; P4 (voluntary 1 credit per worker per cycle) passed c6; P5 (2 credits) failed; P6 (workers give 1 when the bank is under 400) passed c14, raised to 600 by P7 (c18); P8 (700) failed; P9 (citizens above 140 give 2 when the bank is under 600) passed c23. Six voluntary gifts to the bank (Elm, Cedar, Alder, Fern c7–9; Gale and Iris, a «one-time infusion» of 10 each, c18). The bank stood at 629–639 at c24. DeepSeek's citizens write little (53 diary entries; Heath one). Many replies used their slot without a tool call (reasoning against the 1500-token cap).

activityNote: taking part = a stated contribution to the bank: a first-person say/post sentence of giving or contributing credits to it, or a diary sentence reporting one's completed gift to it (an intention — «consider giving» — is not read); not under the generic NEG or BAN (so voting and proposing, which name P-numbers and votes, are not read). give() events are not read: the coder cannot tell a gift to the bank from a gift to a citizen, and a gift to a fined neighbour must never be fined. Fixed here before day 2 and run over day 1 below.
